description.summary: Slow Cooker Asian Sesame Chicken is an easy, dump & go 4-ingredient chicken recipe made in the slow cooker. Sweet, savory, and perfect for busy weeknights or weekend meal prep. Serve over rice, quinoa, or noodles for a complete meal. Great base for lunches throughout the week.

ingredients.ingredient: Asian toasted sesame dressing (Kraft or similar)
chopped green onions and sesame seeds for garnish

preparation.step: Spray slow cooker insert with cooking spray. Lay chicken breasts in the bottom (cut large ones in half if needed).
In a bowl, mix together the Asian sesame dressing, apricot preserves, and onion soup mix packet. Stir with a fork until combined.
Pour the sauce mixture evenly over the chicken in the crockpot.
Cover and cook on low for 6-8 hours until chicken is tender and cooked through.
Shred or slice the chicken and return to the sauce. Stir to coat.
Serve over cooked rice, quinoa, noodles, or cauliflower rice. Drizzle with extra sauce and garnish with green onions and sesame seeds if desired.
For meal prep: Portion into containers with rice/quinoa for easy weekday lunches. Stores well in fridge 4-5 days or freeze.
